stack: npm run demo (Docker Compose), one container per service, the full Traefik gateway path
host: MacBook, 12 CPUs, Docker VM with 7.75 GiB memory
replicas: One instance of every service. Scaling to several replicas was not part of this project, so no replica comparison is claimed.
resourceLimits: Tutor is capped at 0.5 CPU by compose.yaml; every other service is uncapped.
real: Booking/PostgreSQL (real service, real gRPC availability calls)
catalogue: 5 approved demo tutors, 5 subjects, read-only search; no accounts or subjects were created for the k6 runs

runs.profile: 20 students book one slot at once, then 10 same-key replays

notes: Capacity limit was not reached: both k6 runs passed every threshold at the highest load tried. Signing up 20 students at once returned HTTP 500 for about a quarter of requests (root cause found later and fixed, see ../compose-2026-11-10), so the race test signs students up four at a time.
